texts: Silken threads are the deposits that nightmoths leave on lantern rims.
Silken threads are fine, grey, and slightly sticky.
A Keeper scrapes the threads off the warm stone with a flat blade.
A well-attended lantern yields a small heap of threads each night in moth-season.

fields.sentence: Silken threads are the deposits that nightmoths leave on lantern rims.

q2_gaps: identificational copular with a DEFINITE predicate nominal - 'X are the Ns that Y V' - only 'X is a/an N' is covered, so the identity/exhaustivity of 'are THE deposits' collapses to a plain Inheritance and the restrictive relative clause has to be hoisted into a separate top-level generic rule

a possessor/part noun-noun compound ('lantern rims') occurring as a bare-plural KIND-level filler: the prescribed non-fusing PartOf route needs two individuals, and nothing licenses a kind-level part-whole link, so the only available move was to fuse lantern_rim and emit genus rim
review.notes: Within what is covered the parse is right: silken_thread fuses as a material adjective + head with both genus atoms, nightmoth takes the solid-spelling genus, the relative clause becomes a 0.9 distributing rule, and 'on lantern rims' is the event-side Location oblique.

fields.sentence: Silken threads are fine, grey, and slightly sticky.

q2_gaps: a degree modifier on a bare-plural generic ('slightly sticky'): every Degree example has an individual bearer, so the instruction set never fixes whether a kind may fill the Degree bearer slot, nor which truth value the resulting atom takes — the 'the dial reaches every kind-level claim, whatever its head' rule points to 0.9 confidence while the QuantifierPhrase companion precedent keeps a surface-record companion at 1.0/0.99 (the parse chose 1.0/0.99)
review.notes: Material-adjective fusion into silken_thread with both the head genus and the exposed adjectival modifier genus is correct, as is 0.9/0.9 on each of the three conjoined empirical property atoms and retaining the positive 'sticky' under the downtoner.

fields.sentence: A Keeper scrapes the threads off the warm stone with a flat blade.

review.notes: Motion-result shape is exactly per doctrine (Theme on the displaced threads, Source for 'off', no Result atom); the definite plural gets a group witness, 'warm' and 'flat' stay unfused descriptive properties, capitalized 'A Keeper' correctly gets no Name atom, and the indefinite verbal subject stays a witness rather than a generic rule.

fields.sentence: A well-attended lantern yields a small heap of threads each night in moth-season.

q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance well_attended attended) decomposes a compound ADJECTIVE, which the Compound-concepts section says to leave opaque — its decomposition licences cover compound kinds, compound actions, phrasal verbs and agent-nominalizations only.

q2_gaps: hyphenated adverb + participle compound adjective ('well-attended'): no stated rule on whether it gets a genus atom or stays one opaque property symbol
review.notes: 'each night' → (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day) with no status atom matches the 'every morning' habitual pattern exactly, 'a small heap of threads' matches the flock-of-birds shape with 'small' licensed as a property of the collection itself, and the indefinite subject correctly stays a witness (a verbal generic needs a bare plural or explicit quantifier). Roles are right: transitive inanimate subject stays Agent, and the yielded heap is created so it is Patient.

issues.reason: The "leave opaque" bullet names adjective / CONDITION compounds (solid_at_room_temperature) pending a conditional-property representation, not an adverb+participle adjective, while the section's general mandate ("when a compound symbol is genuinely needed, also emit decomposition atoms") and the prompt's own fused adjectival property — (Inheritance sensitive_to_light sensitive) — license a genus atom; (Inheritance well_attended attended) is true (well-attended entails attended) and well-typed, since properties-as-classes take Inheritance.

gaps_confirmed: hyphenated adverb + participle compound adjective ("well-attended"): no stated rule on whether it gets a genus atom or stays one opaque property symbol, which the "exposure is determined, not optional" principle says should be settled
adjudication.notes: The rest is doctrinal: indefinite subject with a verbal predicate stays a witness, "a small heap of threads" takes the flock-of-birds Member+GroupOf shape with small licensed as a property of the collection itself, Agent for the inanimate transitive subject and Patient for the created heap, and "each night" → (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day) with no status atom matches the "every morning" habitual pattern.
